about: The people domain's truth mappings for claims about people (kernel/speech.py truth(); VERIFY_HARDENING 13.1-13.3; WP-D people). Words from house_sim/data/vocab/core.json (home, away) and house_sim/data/vocab/people.json (fever). Conditions read a person's own record (state people.<pid>). states: a person is home when present (common.present: not away; a person record always carries a role, so a resident without an away flag is home), away when their away flag is set (they left through a door or their schedule took them out); the role condition makes both words person-only, so 'the candle is out' about a thing is never scored by them. issues: a fever is a body temperature of 38.0 C or more (the hidden _body_temp_c; a person without one is unknown, never false). acts: 'I let the plumber in' is about the robot's own let_in (the visitor's admitted record, written by let_in); a resident or a key that let them in is not the robot's act, and a claim whose subject the parser names by role alone is left unscored (agency lenient).
